name: Register
descriptor: Dated entries with a signed amount, and the balance after each one.
verify_checks: running: the balance maths is emitted
running: the closing balance is in the strip
pros: the balance after each entry is derived, so it cannot drift
a signed amount makes a payment and a receipt the same kind of record
the order is date then id, so the same entries give the same balances everywhere
it prints like a statement, because it is one
cons: no reconciliation, no categories, no running total per category
no opening balance field: the register starts at zero
entries are edited in place, so history can be rewritten
best_for: a small account you want to see add up
